01 / SHITBRIDGE

Two layers.
One native route.

Shitbridge connects the UTXO payment layer to the NEVM smart-contract layer. Burn on one side, prove it, and receive the corresponding value on the other — without handing coins to a custodian.

LAYER 01 / PAYMENTS

UTXO

Simple, auditable SHIT transfers secured by SHA-256 merged mining.

NEVM

EVM-equivalent execution for Solidity contracts, SHIT-20 tokens and on-chain apps.

03 / THE STACK

Serious machinery.
Unserious ticker.

SHIT is designed as infrastructure, not a token dropped onto somebody else's chain. Payments, contracts, bridging and community apps share one network.

A / SECURITY

Bitcoin merge-mined

SHA-256 miners can secure Shitcoin alongside Bitcoin through AuxPoW, without new mining hardware.

B / PROGRAMMABILITY

EVM-equivalent NEVM

Solidity contracts and familiar EVM tooling, with SHIT as gas and a dedicated mainnet chain ID of 57.

C / LOCK & EARN

Native vault

Consensus-enforced 1–5 year locks with 4%, 6%, 9%, 12% or 15% APY tiers, paid from a capped protocol reserve.

D / ON-CHAIN APPS

ShitSwap + ShitLottery

A native AMM and a lottery where 90% goes to the winner and 10% is burned.

HOW IT WORKS

Contribute. Verify. Unlock.

01 / SEND

Send your contribution to the published address for your coin.

02 / MESSAGE

Message us on X with your transaction hash and your NEVM wallet address.

03 / CLAIM

At chain launch, your schedule is registered in the vesting contract and you claim monthly.

The chain has not launched yet. Presale coins are delivered at chain launch. Until then, your contribution is an IOU recorded against your transaction hash.
